provenance.source_description: The Government of Angola legislation portal links the PDF as “NOVO CÓDIGO PENAL ANGOLANO Lei n.º 38/20 de 11 de Novembro”. The linked facsimile identifies Diário da República, I Série, n.º 179, Wednesday 11 November 2020, and contains Lei n.º 38/20 approving the Penal Code.
provenance.method: Opened the PDF linked from the Government of Angola official legislation page; checked the Gazette masthead, law number/date, title, repeal clause (Article 6) and commencement clause (Article 9).

summary: Approves the Angolan Penal Code. The law expressly repeals the 1886 Penal Code and lists other repealed provisions; Article 9 states that the law enters into force 90 days after publication.
notes: The 2024 Lei n.º 12/24 is directly identified in its own Gazette text as an amendment to Lei n.º 38/20; the relationship is recorded in both records.

The original commencement clause is recorded without calculating a normalized effective date. Current consolidated text and later status beyond the verified amendment have not been exhaustively checked; “amended” is not a certification of present legal effect.
